subject: 🔄 Office Hours Rescheduled — $instructor_name (now $new_booking_date)
body:
Dear $student_name,

Your office hours booking has been rescheduled. The original slot has been released; the replacement details are below — please update your calendar.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
OLD BOOKING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Date:          $old_booking_date  ($old_day_of_week)
Time:          $old_start_time – $old_end_time
Location:      $old_location

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
NEW BOOKING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Booking ID:    $booking_id
Instructor:    $instructor_name ($instructor_id)
Date:          $new_booking_date  ($new_day_of_week)
Time:          $new_start_time – $new_end_time
Location:      $new_location
Rescheduled By:$rescheduled_by
Rescheduled On:$rescheduled_on
Reason:        $reschedule_reason

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

If the new time does not work for you, please cancel via the Student Portal and book an alternative — leaving an unsuitable slot on the calendar prevents another student from taking it.

Kind regards,
Academics Office
